# Project Maya — Technical Summary

**What it is:** An open-source local inference engine (MIT) for large MoE models on consumer PCs, serving GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash via quantized ("Maya-XS/S/M/L") GGUF/EXL3 quants, with a browser chat UI, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs, and a one-command setup.
